boundary_note: Bounded first pass for the ten frozen records without dossiers in Grant's Operations Against Vicksburg [March-July 1863]; the existing MS009 draft is unchanged. Preserve per-engagement dates. MS011's frozen siege interval (May 18–July 4) contains the separate Milliken's Bend (June 7), Goodrich's Landing (June 29–30) and Helena (July 4) engagements; campaign-wide loss figures must not be assigned to any one engagement. Opening personnel and exact effective command boundaries remain unresolved. Draft claims do not alter model inputs.

claims.rationale: No inspected return establishes matched personnel at a common opening boundary. The frozen side-specific numerical strength bounds are blank (missing_numeric_strength). No figure in this pass is adopted as a simultaneous opening force.

claims.value: The frozen force field names the XV Army Corps and Hébert's Brigade without counts; the live field reads zero. NPS says Breese brought eight gunboats and ten transports carrying Blair's division. Hébert lists three gunboats, three of the mosquito fleet and three mortar-boats, and says the transports were over twelve.
claims.rationale: Vessel counts differ between the summary and Hébert, and no troop count is given; none is adopted. Live zeros are not measured absence.

claims.value: The frozen and live results read Confederate victory. NPS says the gunboats returned to their anchorages after Sherman received orders to land his troops at Milliken's Bend; Hébert says the enemy withdrew completely on the night of May 2.
claims.rationale: Retain the original result and engagement interval; later movements and campaign contribution are different measures. No new probabilities or individual causal credit. The engagement was a demonstration; the result label is not a measure of its purpose.

claims.value: The frozen casualty text reads Unknown; the live field reads zero. NPS says the Choctaw took more than fifty hits without casualties but that a battery caused casualties among the landed troops; Sherman says no one was hurt aboard the boats. Hébert reports one lieutenant wounded and captured and two privates wounded, and no casualties on May 1.
claims.rationale: Original casualty returns were not inspected; preserve totals, categories, cutoffs and differences. No canonical reconciliation or casualty-based opening count; related actions must not be added without resolving population overlap. No Union casualty count is inspected.

open_questions: The navy reports and the subordinate officers' reports Hébert forwarded remain deferred.

NPS/CWSAC is one family. Greene is one retrospective history by a non-participant, founded on the Official Records. Each report author selected from Official Records Volumes XXIV and XXII is a separate family of interested accounts; the volumes are shared containers, not additional witnesses, and letters or telegrams by others quoted inside a selected document are not separate families. Report dates are not event times or proof of contemporary knowledge.
No automatic commander attribution, causal campaign score, morale/readiness number or battle/campaign double counting.
